+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AWS_REGION = os.getenv("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")
+SQS_API_VERSION = "2012-11-05"
+
+
+def _dead_letter_queue_url() -> str:
+    url = os.getenv("AWS_SQS_DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_URL")
+    if not url:
+        raise ValueError("AWS_SQS_DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_URL is required")
+    return url
+
+
+def _request_params(queue_url: str, body: str, message_group_id: Optional[str], message_deduplication_id: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    params: Dict[str, str] = {
+        "Action": "SendMessage",
+        "Version": SQS_API_VERSION,
+        "MessageBody": body,
+        "QueueUrl": queue_url,
+    }
+    if message_group_id:
+        params["MessageGroupId"] = message_group_id
+    if message_deduplication_id:
+        params["MessageDeduplicationId"] = message_deduplication_id
+    return params
+
+
+def send_to_dead_letter(
+    failed_message: Dict[str, Any],
+    error_reason: str,
+    *,
+    message_group_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    message_deduplication_id: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    queue_url = _dead_letter_queue_url()
+    payload = {
+        "provider": "aws_sqs",
+        "region": AWS_REGION,
+        "error_reason": error_reason,
+        "failed_message": failed_message,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        "https://sqs.amazonaws.com/",
+        data=_request_params(
+            queue_url,
+            json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False),
+            message_group_id,
+            message_deduplication_id,
+        ),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return {"queued": True, "status_code": response.status_code, "queue_url": queue_url}
+
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def _subscription_path(project_id: str, subscription_name: str) -> str:
+    return f"projects/{project_id}/subscriptions/{subscription_name}"
+
+
+def consume_one_message(project_id: Optional[str] = None, subscription_name: Optional[str] = None, timeout: float = 10.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    project_id = project_id or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    subscription_name = subscription_name or os.environ["PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION"]
+    subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
+    response = subscriber.pull(
+        request={"subscription": _subscription_path(project_id, subscription_name), "max_messages": 1},
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    if not response.received_messages:
+        return {"received": False, "message": None}
+    received = response.received_messages[0]
+    message = received.message
+    payload: Any = message.data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if message.data else ""
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(payload)
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    subscriber.acknowledge(
+        request={"subscription": _subscription_path(project_id, subscription_name), "ack_ids": [received.ack_id]}
+    )
+    return {
+        "received": True,
+        "message": {
+            "message_id": message.message_id,
+            "publish_time": message.publish_time.isoformat() if message.publish_time else None,
+            "attributes": dict(message.attributes),
+            "data": payload,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(consume_one_message(), ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def _publisher_client() -> pubsub_v1.PublisherClient:
+    return pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
+
+
+def publish_event(topic_path: str, event: Dict[str, Any], attributes: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> str:
+    client = _publisher_client()
+    data = json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    future = client.publish(topic_path, data, **(attributes or {}))

+

+    payload = os.environ.get("EVENT_JSON", "{}")
+    event = json.loads(payload)
+    attributes_json = os.environ.get("EVENT_ATTRIBUTES", "{}")
+    attributes = json.loads(attributes_json)
+    message_id = publish_event(topic_path, event, attributes)
+    print(message_id)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
